title: Tiny bug nightclub with a very strict no-exit policy
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 15, 2026
review: I used this to deal with a phorid fly / drain fly situation.It is not some instant bug apocalypse machine, but the sticky cards definitely showed that it was doing its job. There is also something weirdly satisfying about checking the card and seeing proof that the little freeloaders made poor life choices.Setup is simple. I like that it is quiet and does not involve spraying anything around the kitchen. The light doubles as a nice ambient night light for my kitchen. I did notice that it's most effective / catches the most flies overnight.One thing worth mentioning: this helps catch the adults, but you still need to deal with wherever they are coming from. I used it while also cleaning drains and trying to eliminate the source. The trap helped catch the stragglers and gave me a good visual of whether things were improving.Overall, it helped. Not magic, but effective enough that I would use it again if the tiny bug nightclub ever reopens.

title: Working great!
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 15, 2026
review: These have been working great for us, just as good as the name brands at a lower cost! In the summer we get all types of flying bugs getting inside and having these this year has helped significantly! I also kinda enjoy the purple light it gives off at night.

title: Best solution I've tried
date: Reviewed in the United States on April 27, 2026
review: I've been struggling with fungus gnats from my plants for months and I've tried everything. This is by far the best thing I've used. Every day, I see more gnats stuck to the card and I don't have to do anything except change the card when it gets full. It's not noisy like a zapper and the light isn't bothersome. It seems solidly built and the cost is extremely reasonable as well. I just bought more for my other rooms. Oh, and you can get refill cards as well.

title: Works well for catching flies/nats
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 23, 2026
review: I think this product is good and works well for what you are paying for. It catches the flies and nats okay but over the coarse of two days has not caught as many as I think it could. It is easy to put together and very light weight. No scent to this product, in case your wondering if it smells. You can re-use this product for about a week before changing the filter. I am not a fan of how you can see the bugs being caught out in the open, especially since this is primarily used in the kitchen area (at least for me since that is where they hangout the most). Overall it does the job for what you pay for.

title: You will NOT regret this purchase. Buy as many plug ins as you can afford!
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 15, 2026
review: light #1 out of 3. Plugged them in last night. They are all full less than 24hours later. I tried homemade traps. I tried everything. This trap is a life saver. No more drain flies coming for my laptop in the middle of the night. There are 2 different ways to use the traps. The second being covering a cup or water or wine. The cup of wine worked as well but the plug in lights are by far superior. I guess it really depends if the flys have a different source of water available. YOU WILL NOT REGRET THIS PURCHASE. I had to move the lights around to adjust. I found that a flat wall works best for the lights rather than a textured or tiled shiny wall. The light will shine better on regular drywall. 2 out of 3 of my plugs are plugged into a socket by the floor and they still work wonders. The other next to the sink where I believe they initially hatched their eggs in the drain. You should definitely keep one by the front door so any new flies coming in go right for the light before hatching eggs.

title: Simple and somewhat effective
date: Reviewed in the United States on May 12, 2026
review: I think this is a great product, I feel like there should be more gnats that stick, as I see more swarming in my home, but maybe it just takes time.I don’t have another brand to compare this too, I see most people with zevo in their homes but was hoping for a cheaper alternative.It is pretty easy to setup just you might get a bit of the sticky glue on you but it comes off fine.You can see what it looks like at night, some gnats have been stuck already.
